tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.help: list of lamps: label, key, and at most one of when (a Button-grammar condition), flag (annunciate, old, bad, fail) or enum (value -> text); plus on_text, off_text, level and flash_on_change seconds. Red/amber levels only with flag: annunciate

cols.label: Columns
cols.help: columns of tiles; 0 = as many as the tiles need

border_width.label: Tile outline (px)
border_width.help: tile outline thickness; doubled while a change flashes

tile_fields.name: label
tile_fields.label: Label
tile_fields.help: the caption; also the default on and off text

tile_fields.name: when
tile_fields.label: Condition
tile_fields.help: lit while this Button-grammar condition is true

tile_fields.name: flag
tile_fields.label: Key flag
tile_fields.help: lit while the key's own flag is set

tile_fields.name: enum
tile_fields.label: Value to text
tile_fields.help: shows the text mapped to the key's value

tile_fields.name: condition_keys
tile_fields.label: Other keys read
tile_fields.help: other keys the condition reads (each must be fresh too)

tile_fields.name: on_text
tile_fields.label: On text
tile_fields.help: text while lit; blank = the label

tile_fields.name: off_text
tile_fields.label: Off text
tile_fields.help: text while off (drawn dim); blank = the label

tile_fields.name: flash_on_change
tile_fields.label: Flash on change (s)
tile_fields.help: seconds a change is boxed and flashes; 0 = never
